# Switch_Fabric_Bottleneck

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The limitation in switch chip design and packaging that constrains the scale and efficiency of AI cluster interconnects, often due to I/O density and thermal constraints. Identifies the critical hardware constraint that TCC topologies must account for when designing scalable, low-latency network architectures.
